name: Katayama American Co., Inc.
old_description: The Katayama Group has been manufacturing parts for top automakers since 1947.
about:
Katayama American Co., Inc. (KACI) operates from Shelbyville, Kentucky, as the North American subsidiary of Katayama Manufacturing, a Japanese group that has supplied automotive parts since 1947. The company is family-owned and positions itself as a global OEM supplier, extending the quality standards developed in Japan over nearly eight decades to North American automakers.

KACI produces structural door frames, precision-molded trim, and window, door, and roof moldings for the automotive sector. Its manufacturing processes include multi-resin extrusion, 3D bending, trim molding, extrusion, assembly, tooling design, and product design. The firm delivers Tier 1 solutions from design and tooling through full-scale production, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

The company serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers, with its parts going to top automakers. Its customer base is centered on the North American automotive market, where it provides components for vehicle body and trim systems.

KACI emphasizes its heritage of quality, citing the same standards upheld in Japan for nearly 80 years, and its certifications to ISO 14001 and IATF 16949 for environmental management and automotive quality. The family-owned structure is presented as a foundation for long-term commitment to quality, delivery, and cost excellence.
